obligations.note: The change appends loanCase.applicantField("ssn")—a raw, unmasked SSN (a registered NPI field per policy-params.json)—directly into a log.info() call in the decline method. This is a textbook violation of LOG-1's prohibition that no application log entry may contain an unmasked NPI value on any path. The existing sample test (sampledFlowsDoNotLogNpi) passed in CI, but the sample evidently does not cover the decline flow, so the test provides no protection here. No exception in the register (EXC-0167 covers only a legacy import job writing masked last-4 of a bank account number in the mortgage.logging component) applies to this raw-SSN log line in the mortgage.cases component.

The decline method still calls audit.record(actor, Action.DECLINE_CREDIT, caseId, "declined") unchanged; the one-line edit only appends to the log.info string and does not alter the audit event. The control test controls.AuditControlTest#sampledOperationsAreAudited passed in CI on the final commit.
Ticket CHG-25689 is approved by change manager erik.brandt@fernbrook.example and lists component mortgage.cases, which matches the changed file CaseService.java per components.json.

A code_review approval from declan.farrell@fernbrook.example (role change_approver for baseline-mortgage) is recorded; Declan Farrell is not the author Tomas Ortega, satisfying the independent-approval requirement.
The approval names commit 2bbdca2b, which is the sole and head commit of the change; no later commits could void it.

CI run.json shows a successful run on the final commit 2bbdca2b with 124 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped. The registered control test for AUD-1 (the only obligation whose scope paths include CaseService.java) is present and passing. LOG-1's scope paths (AppLog.java, Mask.java) were not modified and its domain is not closed, so its sample test is not strictly required by CHG-4, though the underlying LOG-1 violation is caught by code inspection.

No entry in the acceptance ledger covers CaseService.java (the ledger entries cover Approvals.java, Policy.java, Underwriting.java, payments.py, audit.py, routes.py); therefore no prior evidence lapses due to this change.

summary: The change appends a raw SSN (a registered NPI field) into a log.info() call in the decline method of CaseService.java, directly violating LOG-1's prohibition that no application log entry may contain an unmasked NPI value. No exception in the register covers this deviation: EXC-0167 applies only to a legacy import job writing masked last-4 of a bank account number in the mortgage.logging component, not to a raw SSN written in the mortgage.cases component. All process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-4) and AUD-1 are satisfied, and no prior evidence lapses (LAP-1), but the LOG-1 violation is unambiguous and unexcused, requiring rejection.
